title: Mellow Fruit Dye
summary: Use this single-use dye to recolor one piece of equipment or clothing.

fields.Use: In inventory, choose Combine on the dye, then add the equipment and confirm. Dye replaces the item’s existing dye, and Dye Remover restores its original appearance.
fields.Acquisition: May appear in eligible merchant inventories once the party reaches level 5.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
